steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each work package is placed by its planned value, its actual cost and its percent complete.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Actual cost with no planned value
Variance does not follow from the figures

outcome.notChecked: Whether the percent complete is accurate.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] wp-04.csv:12  Percent complete over 100.
       Fix: Correct the percent complete.
[medium] wp-02.csv:19  Actual cost with no planned value.
       Fix: Add the planned value.
[low] wp-06.csv:26  Variance does not follow from the figures.
       Fix: Recompute the variance.
Not checked: Whether the percent complete is accurate.
pros: Checks a package with percent complete over 100, an actual cost with no planned value, and a variance that does not follow from the figures.
cons: Not checked: Whether the percent complete is accurate.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-budget-burn skill on the records for this review.
